cer_canadas_energy_future: Canadian energy and macroeconomic projections conditional on the selected report edition and policy scenario.
  - macro-indicators: Canada-level real GDP, deflator and exchange-rate series; macroeconomic paths provide provincial transport-demand growth proxies and currency-conversion inputs.
faa_economic_values: U.S. air-carrier capacity, utilization and maintenance evidence for the year ending June 2023, aggregated separately for passenger and freight aircraft.
  - section_3_capacity: Passenger and freight All Aircraft capacity, load, speed and utilization averages used to normalize aircraft costs to transport service.
  - section_4_operating_costs: Passenger and freight All Aircraft maintenance expense per block hour in reviewed 2023 USD; underlying carrier data end in June 2023.

nlr_atb_transportation: U.S. road-vehicle technology trajectories and operating assumptions by class and powertrain; Canadian fleet weighting and service conversion are applied separately.
  - vehicles: U.S. vehicle technology and retail-equivalent price trajectories in 2022 USD; MHDV gasoline/CNG variants are absent, requiring mapped proxies. Manufacturing-cost conversion is applied separately.
anl_autonomie_bean: MHDV age-based maintenance-and-repair coefficients in reviewed 2020 USD; limited class/powertrain coverage requires mapped proxies.
epri_us_regen_transportation: U.S. modeled transport technology cost and efficiency assumptions; relative changes and technology coverage are specific to the registered component.
  - intercity_bus_charts: Intercity-bus purchase-price and fuel-economy trajectories; purchase costs use the reviewed 2023 USD basis.
